reviewFlags.issue: The traklin.co.il spec table gives freezer net volume as 41 L, while bug.co.il and the traklin.co.il description give 5 L. The catalog's 5 L matches two pages and was kept.
The traklin.co.il dimension table gives 488, 442 and 475 (unit ס״מ), which conflicts with bug.co.il's 48, 49 and 44 ס״מ. The traklin figures look like a typo and were not used.
The catalog name says מיני בר, but both retailer pages call it a מקרר משרדי or מקרר קובייה with a freezer compartment. No page says mini bar. Check the category and name.
bug.co.il writes the model as PR50W and traklin.co.il writes it as PR-50W. Both match the catalog number once the hyphen is ignored.
The warranty text names אס גי אלקטרוניקה as the warranty handler. No manufacturer or importer page confirmed the importer, so it was left null.
Catalog name says מיני בר; both retailer pages describe it as מקרר משרדי / מקרר קובייה with a freezer compartment. Check name and category wording.
traklin.co.il spec table lists freezer volume 41 L, contradicting 5 L on both pages' descriptions; 5 L was kept.
traklin.co.il dimension table shows 488/442/475 ס״מ, apparently a listing error; bug.co.il values were used.
Warranty text mentions אס גי אלקטרוניקה but importer not confirmed; left empty.
Catalog weight 13 ק״ג and removable wire shelf were not verified by a quote and are not published.

qa.notes: All facts are supported by ok quotes on two Israeli retailer pages naming PR50W / PR-50W. Cooling method value reworded to include manual defrost meaning. Feature 5 typo in source ('הסתרת') published as 'מוסתרת'. Traklin spec-table freezer 41 L and dimension figures 488/442/475 were not used (likely listing errors). Catalog weight 13 kg and removable wire shelf were not offered as facts and are not published.
